methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was verified against each provider's official pricing page on the accessedAt date. Providers were selected from the seed list (Eventbrite, Ticket Tailor, TryBooking, TicketSpice, Tix) plus high-volume alternatives (Universe, Eventzilla, RegFox, Accelevents). TryBooking was excluded: its website geolocates to AU/NZ/UK with no published USD pricing page. All per-ticket fee platforms are modeled as billingModel 'custom' (usage-metered with no flat monthly commitment), with the published per-ticket rate in notes. Plans that require contacting sales have monthlyUsd null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony). Ticket Tailor's official pricing page returned HTTP 403; pricing was sourced from SoftwareAdvice (softwareadvice.com) and Capterra (capterra.com) reputable comparison pages, corroborated by current web search of the live site, and is noted as such. Note: an earlier draft listed $0.65/ticket pay-as-you-sell and $0.26 lowest prepaid for Ticket Tailor; on re-verification 2026-06-14 multiple current sources show $0.75/ticket pay-as-you-sell and $0.28 lowest prepaid (the live site has since moved to $0.85), so those figures were corrected. Tix pricing page returned HTTP 403; pricing was sourced from SoftwareAdvice and GetApp comparison pages and confirmed by web search ($0.25/ticket box office, $1.50/ticket online).

plans.name: Free Events
plans.notes: No fees for events with free tickets. Unlimited free events. All core platform features included.

plans.name: Paid Events (Standard)
plans.notes: No monthly fee. Per-ticket charges: 3.7% + $1.79 service fee per ticket, plus 2.9% payment processing fee per order. Organizer can choose to pass fees to attendees or absorb them. No flat-rate plan available for paid events.

plans.name: Pro (Email Marketing Add-on)
plans.notes: Starting at $15/month for email marketing add-on. Allows sending up to 10,000 emails daily to attendees. Ticketing fees still apply separately.

plans.name: Enterprise / Sales Partnership
plans.notes: Custom solutions for complex or high-volume events. Contact sales required. No published price.

vendors.name: Ticket Tailor
vendors.provenance: tickettailor.com pricing page returned HTTP 403. Pricing sourced from softwareadvice.com/event-booking/ticket-tailor-profile/ and capterra.com/p/112510/Ticket-Tailor/pricing/ (reputable comparison pages, accessed 2026-06-14). Both agree on $0.75/ticket pay-as-you-sell and prepaid credits as low as $0.28/ticket; live-site web search showed the pay-as-you-sell rate moving to $0.85. An earlier draft's $0.65/$0.26 figures were not corroborated and were corrected.

plans.name: Free Events
plans.notes: No fees for free events. First 5 tickets sold on any account are also free. Unlimited events and ticket types.

plans.name: Pay As You Sell
plans.notes: $0.75 per ticket sold (pay-as-you-sell), per SoftwareAdvice and Capterra; the live site has since moved to ~$0.85/ticket per current web search. No monthly fee. No fee for free tickets. Charity/nonprofit discount available. Includes mobile tickets, event scheduling, ticket grouping, unlimited events/ticket types, waitlists. Prior draft's $0.65 figure was uncorroborated and corrected.

plans.name: Pay Upfront (Credits)
plans.notes: Prepay for ticket credits; per-ticket rate reduces to as low as $0.28/ticket at higher volume (SoftwareAdvice and Capterra both report $0.28 as the lowest prepaid rate). No monthly subscription. All same features as Pay As You Sell. Prior draft's $0.26 figure was uncorroborated and corrected to $0.28.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $0.99 per ticket sold (reduced to $0.49 per ticket for tickets priced under $5). No monthly fee, no setup fee, no contracts. Credit card processing 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction (separate). All features included: ticketing page builder, reserved seating, ticket scanning, box office app, branding, CRM, analytics, API access.

plans.name: Email Marketing Automation Add-on
plans.notes: $9/month + $0.02 per recipient. Optional add-on.

plans.name: Text Message Platform Add-on
plans.notes: $19/month + $0.02 per recipient. Optional add-on.

vendors.name: Tix
vendors.provenance: tix.com pricing page returned HTTP 403. Pricing sourced from softwareadvice.com and getapp.com comparison pages (accessed 2026-06-14). Both agree on Box Office $0.25/ticket and Online $1.50/ticket per-ticket pricing model.

plans.name: Box Office
plans.notes: $0.25 per ticket sold (box office / in-person sales channel). No monthly subscription. CRM, multiple seating configurations, integrations included.

plans.name: Online
plans.notes: $1.50 per ticket sold (online sales channel). No monthly subscription. Same core features as Box Office plan.

plans.name: Free Events
plans.notes: Zero service fees for events with free tickets. No setup costs or termination fees.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: No monthly fee. 2% + $0.59 per ticket sold (excludes VAT and payment processing). Targeted at independent organizers. Core dashboard, payouts, custom checkout questions, email support, real-time analytics, unlimited ticket types.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: No monthly fee. Same 2% + $0.59 per ticket rate as Starter. Adds cardholder presales, priority email support, payment plans, tiered ticketing. Targeted at growing brands.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Custom pricing / a la carte plan. Contact sales required. Adds dynamic pricing, custom badges, event marketing, RFID access control. Targeted at established organizers.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $1.50 per registration. Unlimited free registrations at no cost. 1 paid ticket type. 100 email invitations. Business hours support. Standard registration form. Unlimited events.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 1.9% + $1.50 per registration. Unlimited paid ticket types, customizable forms, seating plans, discount codes, agenda builder, speaker management. 500 email invitations per event. Automated event reminders.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 2.9% + $1.50 per registration. Most Popular tier. White-labeled registration experience, advanced website designer, sponsor management, virtual event hosting, email campaigns. 1,000 email invitations per event.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: $5,999/year billed annually ($499.92/month equivalent). Flat fee covers unlimited registrations across all events. 2 full users included, dedicated account manager, higher email credits, onboarding assistance.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Quote-only for high-volume events and agencies. Contact sales required.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $0/month base. Per-registrant fee: $0.99 + 1% per paid registration (capped at $4.99/registration). $0.99 per free-event registrant. Credit card processing 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction separate. No setup fees, no contracts.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $0/month base. Per-registrant fee: $1.99 + 1% per paid registration (capped at $5.99/registration). $1.99 per free-event registrant. Adds advanced features over Standard. Credit card processing 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction separate.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $499/month billed annually. Per-registrant fee: $1.99 + 1% (capped at $5.99). $0.99 per free-event registrant. Includes full feature set with priority support. Credit card processing 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction separate.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Starting from $7,500 per event (annual billing implied). 1 event. Unlimited registrations, custom fields, self check-in, badge printing, integrations. No transaction fees.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Starting from $13,500 (annual). Unlimited events. Adds event listing page, cross-event reporting, custom reporting. All Professional features.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Unlimited events, approval workflows, call for speakers, API/webhooks, multi-department operations.

plans.name: White Label
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Full brand removal, custom URL, custom email domain, branded mobile app, SSO. All Enterprise features.
